observations: Photo 0: a single wooden pallet (4-board top deck, block style) on a concrete/tiled floor, 'POSTED ON JIJI GOLDNEST' watermark, no scale or certificate visible.
Photo 1: another single wooden pallet, similar construction, slight crack visible in one board, no scale or weighing equipment shown.
Photo 2: a large stack of multiple wooden pallets outdoors near a warehouse, no count markers, no scale, no certificate visible.
No photo shows a weighing scale, a certificate, a moisture meter, or any water/soaking evidence.
No brand, model, or manufacturer mark is legible on any pallet.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added
claims.evidence: No photo shows moisture testing or close-up of wood condition confirming dryness; this phrasing also pre-empts a known pallet-trade scam (soaking wood to inflate sale weight), which raises rather than lowers doubt.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: No scale, weighbridge ticket, or certificate is shown in any of the 3 photos.

risks.risk: Wood may have been soaked or left damp to inflate the weighed mass, since pallets are apparently being sold by weight.
risks.proof: Photo or video of a moisture meter reading on multiple pallets, or a dated weighing slip from a certified scale.
risks.if_unproven: price as if weight includes retained moisture, i.e. treat the effective dry/sellable wood mass as lower than claimed 500 kg

risks.risk: Number of individual pallets in the lot is not stated, so per-unit value cannot be derived from the total weight claim.
risks.proof: A photo showing all pallets laid out with a visible count, or an itemized list/invoice.
risks.if_unproven: price the visible single units only, not the claimed full weighed lot

risks.risk: Pallets may have structural damage (cracked boards, broken blocks) not visible from the angles shown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the underside/blocks of each pallet and any visibly cracked boards.
risks.if_unproven: price as moderate-condition stock, not premium/structurally sound

proof_requests: A photo or video of the pallets on the certified scale showing the live reading.
A clear count of how many individual pallets make up the 500 kg lot.
Close-up photos of the pallet undersides/blocks and any cracked or repaired boards.
A moisture meter reading or similar proof that no water was added.
response.reason: The item is a lot of wooden pallets sold by weight, but the only comparables supplied are individual plastic pallets priced per unit, which do not match the material, condition basis, or sale unit of the item seen, so no valid price range can be derived from them.
